# Label
Names a form control and extends its click target. Renders as a native label associated with the control by htmlFor.

USE WHEN
• Above or beside every Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox and Switch, and above a group of them
• Marking a field as required or optional (use the Required / Optional switches, never a typed asterisk)

DON'T USE WHEN
• As a heading, legend or body copy
• Wrapping an unrelated block of content
• The control already renders its own label (Checkbox and Switch given a label prop)

DO
• Match htmlFor to the control's id
• Keep the label size in step with the control size
• Use Required or Optional, not both; Required wins if both are on

DON'T
• Repeat the label text in the placeholder
• Set aria-required on the label; it belongs on the control

PROPERTIES
• Variant: default | inline — default sits stacked above the control; inline sits beside it (checkbox and switch rows) and drops the space below the label. Both draw identically here; the difference is layout only.
• Size: sm (12) | md (14) | lg (16) — match the linked control's size
• State: default | disabled | error — error turns the label danger-coloured; disabled mirrors the control's disabled colour
• Required: boolean — shows the * marker
• Optional: boolean — shows the "(optional)" hint

CODE    <Label> in @atlas/ui-web/primitives/Label
